_readme: Standing Orders playbook TEMPLATE. Copy to data/standing_orders.json (or LUMOS_STANDING_ORDERS_PATH), edit the orders, set LUMOS_STANDING_ORDERS_TOKEN in .env, then run `lumos orders sign`. The node refuses this file until it carries a valid signature. Actions allowed: dossier, note, briefing, discord_dm, workspace_file.

do.prefix: 🔴 RED disaster near a watched zone — dossier:

do.text: LION LOCK — Regulus due east; Sphinx gaze line.

orders.name: flare-watch
orders._note: Fires on any flare at/above LUMOS_COSMIC_TRIGGER_MIN_FLARE_CLASS (M by default). Add "magnitude_text": "X" to when{} to restrict to X-class only. Logs a timestamped entry + compiles a space-weather dossier so the flare is on record for flare->quake correlation.

do.text: FLARE logged — watching for follow-on seismic per RHC flare->quake model.

orders.name: quake-watch
orders._note: Fires on any quake at/above LUMOS_COSMIC_TRIGGER_MIN_EQ_MAGNITUDE. Logs it alongside the flare log so you can correlate lead time / location / magnitude after the fact.

do.text: QUAKE logged — cross-reference against recent flare entries for lead-time / 300mi / 0.3M scoring.
